_source: CORE ELA Pacing Guide Grade 2 - Open Up EL Education, uploaded 8/30/26, transcribed by week (parsed from the guide's M | U | L labels and lesson titles, cross-checked against Appendix A's Grade 2 ELA bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md).
_note: Module = EL Education Module, Unit = the Unit within that Module (unit stored as a string; lesson numbers reset per Unit, unlike OUR Math, which is why every week segments strictly on module/unit changes with no cross-unit merging - weeks 3, 6, 24 and 33 each carry two segments for this reason). 'assessment' on a segment names any Unit Assessment / Performance Task / Benchmark Assessment Cycle that falls within that segment's lessons - 'Part I/II/III'/session numbers and colon detail are dropped, keeping only the base tag, matching Grade 1's own file; a tag repeated across multiple lessons in the same segment (e.g. 'Unit 2 Assessment, Part I' and 'Part II' both landing in week 5) is written once, not doubled. 'Preparing for the Unit N Assessment' lead-in lessons (weeks 17, 23) are not tagged - only the assessment itself is. Benchmark Assessment Cycle mentions sit in the guide's 'Skills Block Lessons' portion of a week's table, physically after that week's Module Lessons, so they attach to whichever module/unit segment is current at that point in the week (weeks 1, 20, 29 and 30); the generic 'Review previous cycles based on assessment results' Skills Block note in weeks 31-36 names no specific cycle and is not tagged. Verified against Appendix A: all 36 weeks' lesson titles and assessment placement confirmed line-for-line, including the two-segment weeks.

1.assessment: Benchmark Assessment Cycle 1 + Benchmark Assessment Cycle 2
